# health-aggregator

> Concurrent dependency health checks with per-check timeouts, critical versus optional checks, an up/degraded/down status, TTL caching and an HTTP handler. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u043-health-aggregator`, package `health`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
